Definition: properly, to fasten (or make firm), i.e. to close (the eyes)
BiblicalUsage: The proverb says a man who shuts his eyes to devise froward things, and moves his lips, brings evil to pass. The word is the closing of the eyes, the deliberate shutting out of light.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that evil begins with a shut eye, because the man who will not see good has already decided to do harm.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
